comment.body: Thanks for the earlier confirmed snap-back reproductions on 0.53.1/0.53.3 and the maintainer's 2022 repro. The January 2025 note on 0.87.1 describes layouts missing on desktops 3, 5, and 6, which may differ from the original window snapping back to its previous zone. On the latest stable PowerToys, could you confirm which symptom still occurs? If the layout-loss symptom remains, please share a short numbered sequence identifying the affected monitor/layout and whether the original snap-back sequence still reproduces. This will tell us whether the old behavior remains or the current symptom needs separate tracking.
